newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds, futures choppy with U.S. seen supported.
newsitem.headline: Bunds, futures choppy with U.S. seen supported.

text.p: German debt spent a rather choppy session mimicking movements in U.S. Treasuries almost tick for tick on Tuesday.
U.S. data showing April retail sales dwon 0.3 percent on the month -- in line with expectations -- pushed debt markets higher initially but then prices came off.

"There seemed to be some quite good buying already ahead of the release of retail sales, and when it came the market went up, but then we saw some profit-taking in the U.S. and Germany," said an anlayst at DMG futures and options in Frankfurt.
